decisions.Kwic: 繫念乖真昏沈不好拈云：瞎睡漢！

Decision.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Zhenxie Qingliao (真歇清了禪師語錄), line-by-line comments on Sengcan's Faith in Mind. Sengcan is the source speaker of the displayed line 繫念乖真，昏沈不好. Zhenxie Qingliao's exact response begins only after 拈云 with 'blind sleeping fellow' and continues as commentary; the title owner therefore does not speak the stored headword phrase.
